messages:
Lara: Hey team — quick design review request for the Rule Editor compactness vs density exploration. Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/rules-compact-vs-dense
Lara: Main question — do we keep the compact stacked rules (less scrolling) or higher density with inline affordances for conditions? Thoughts on discoverability + a11y? @Jon @Priya @Marco
Jon: Overall I prefer a middle ground. Compact is nice but keyboard focus order becomes harder. If we go compact, we need clear focus rings and an explicit focusable affordance for drag/priority (not just the whole row).
Jon: Also: when a rule is selected, the inspector panel should do aria-live="polite" updates so screen readers get context when priority changes.
Priya: Agree. Also copy nits on validation messages — we should avoid jargon. Current: "Invalid: missing condition" -> proposed: "Add at least one condition so this rule can match requests." Short, action-oriented.
Priya: Small example microcopy: `Add a condition to start matching requests. Need help? See rule examples.`
Marco: UX note — preview simulation currently shows rules sorted by created_at when priorities tie. That confuses PMs because they expect stable-order-by-priority then manual pin. Suggest explicit tiny badge: "Pinned" and if same priority, show a subtle reorder handle + tooltip: "Rules with equal priority use manual order."
Marco: Also noticed the preview spinner hangs if you toggle simulation rapidly. Might be debounce issue, sending logs to eng-runtime.
Jon: Contrast check: the muted labels in compact mode drop below WCAG AA for 14px body. We should bump weight or color. Quick diff: #6B6F76 -> #52565A passes AA for 14px.
Priya: For validation UX: when a rule fails preview validation, we currently show a red toast. Proposal: inline inline pill on the rule row that says "Preview failed" with `aria-describedby` linking to the failure details panel. Less disruptive than a toast.
Lara: Love the inline pill idea. Keeps context. Make sure we include keyboard affordance to open details (Enter/Space).
design-bot: Snapshot: Compact-vs-Dense-2026-03-23 created by Lara. Link: https://figma.com/snapshot/xyz
design-bot: Automated contrast report flagged 3 labels below AA in compact mode (ids: lbl-12, lbl-15, lbl-18).
Marco: For ordering UI: consider a tiny priority dropdown + drag handle instead of making the whole row draggable. That reduces accidental drags on mobile and for keyboard users.
Jon: Accessibility on drag handles: role="button" aria-pressed? Better to have role="separator"? I think role="button" with aria-label="Reorder rule" is fine and add aria-grabbed while dragging. We should coordinate with eng on the drag library semantics.
Priya: Copy suggestion for empty-state in preview: current: "No simulation results" -> proposed: "Run a preview to see which rules match a sample request. Tip: pick a sample payload from the dropdown." More helpful.
Lara: Action items: 1) Priya to ship updated microcopy and inline pill copy. 2) Jon to spec focus order & aria-live notes. 3) Marco to update preview ordering behavior & file debounce bug. 4) I'll add a follow-up Figma with the inline pill and pinned badge.
Lara: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Marco: :eyes: I'll start a tiny PR for the pinned badge copy and attach the simulation repro steps.
Jon: I'll sync with eng-runtime on aria-grabbed and the debounce.
Priya: I'll push copy suggestions to the Figma text layers and include the empty-state tip.
Lara: Great — we'll review again after those changes.
